title: Design: Work order Customer card shows Bill To This customer under Authorizer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer B with no saved Bill Invoices To, so the customer bills itself.
  • Have a new open work order for this test for customer B (an Estimate is fine) that bills itself, so its Bill To reads This customer.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p2-02-after-this-customer.png, bt-p2-01-before-customer-card.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The customer card shows, in order: Contact, Phone, Authorizer, Bill To.
  • Bill To has a small grey label and the value "This customer" under it, in the same grey label and value sizes as the rows above it (no border, arrow or button at rest).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R1: “The card's expanded section shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer.”
  • S3-R2: “The field reads "This customer" when the customer pays for itself, otherwise the Bill To's name.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
